R3A-grouse-walk-0002.name: By Slim Creek
R3A-grouse-walk-0002.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
R3A-grouse-walk-0002.parkWhat: pull off on Slim Creek FSR (gravel road)

evidence.t: Road: Slim Creek FSR, 3.8 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
3 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
15 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

flags.t: Spot is inside a Motor Vehicle Closed Area: Spruce Lake. Closed June 1 to November 30. Synopsis map 1-2/23.
Route enters a Motor Vehicle Closed Area: Thompson, Cariboo and Okanagan Alpines. Closed Year Round. Exemption: Snowmobiles exempt year round (January 1 to December 31). Synopsis map 1-82/24.
Above 1,700 m: in Region 3 no motor vehicles except snowmobiles, except on existing roads and trails (synopsis page 33, 99%). Elevation from terrain tiles (estimate).

seasonRows.notes: youth only: hunters under 18 (page footnote); New, printed green
MU 3-32 is not listed in the Region 3 sharp tailed grouse rows (my reading of the table).

plan: Drive: from Resort Municipality of Whistler, about 116 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 99, Pemberton Meadows Rd, Upper Lillooet River FSR, Hurley River FSR.
Park: 50.91426, -122.93028, pull off on Slim Creek FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk 7.9 km to the start. Walk: the Slim Creek FSR stretch, 3.8 km one way. About 75 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 3-32, Region 3. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-27, closures 2026-10-16.
R3A-grouse-walk-0002.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 3-32: about 7,373 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 1.90 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

Walk: 11 km W, on Slim Creek FSR. Climb about 97 m, about 234 min at 3 km/h.
